name: Black Coffee
source:
I made you black coffee, just like you like it. Now, let's talk.

A short game about a meeting that never was and words that were never said.

[From [url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/black-coffee]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我给你泡了黑咖啡，就像你喜欢的那样。现在，我们来谈谈吧。

一个关于从未有过的会面和从未说过的话的小游戏。

[来自[url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/black-coffee]Itch.io[/url]]
